rdfs:label: categories
rdfs:comment: iCalendar categories for a Vevent/Vtodo/Vjournal — free-text keywords classifying the item ("work", "travel"); in RDF give one value per keyword rather than a comma-joined string.
notes: Free-form strings, no controlled vocabulary by default. Distinct from `as:tag` (ActivityStreams tag links) and `dcat:keyword` (dataset keyword). Use `categories` when you need iCal-format calendar interop; the other two are better for fediverse posts and dataset metadata respectively. Also distinct from `urn:solid:hasTopic` (bookmark topic folders).

history.note: Comment: one value per keyword in RDF, not comma-joined; added hasTopic to notToBeConfusedWith.
